changelog:
- Initial release of the pp-olx skill.
- Provides CLI integration with olx-pp-cli for interacting with OLX.pl job-listings via a reverse-engineered API.
- Includes detailed setup, command reference, and usage instructions.
- Supports agent mode, output delivery to multiple sinks, named profiles, and feedback collection.
- No authentication required; covers error handling and exit codes.
summary: Printing Press CLI for Olx. OLX.pl job-listings reverse-engineered API (public, no auth)
